messages:
Devon: Quick async check — onboarding Delta-v1 for catalog. Where are the weights landed and has anyone noticed the tokenizer producing extra <|pad|> tokens on short prompts? Need to run a smoke perf (latency p50/p95) and verify batch config before I kick a full sweep.

Maria: weights are in s3://redwood-models/delta/v1/weights.tar.gz. I untarred locally and ran a quick tokenization pass. Noticed the vocab has an extra <|pad|> ID (token id 2) and our tokenizer config still expects no pad token. Could cause off-by-one in batching. :eyes:

Samir: Re: tokenizer — that matches what I saw when converting from hf. The tokenizer.json includes "pad_token": "<|pad|>" but model config has "max_position_embeddings": 2048 while our serving config defaults to 2048 as well, so mismatch not there. The real issue is that the tokenizer has an explicit pad id and our padding pipeline was using `pad_to_multiple_of` which triggers extra tokens for short inputs. Quick fix: set `padding=False` in the smoke runner to compare raw lengths.

Maria: repro command I used:
```bash
python -m scripts.tokenize_sample --model-dir /tmp/delta --input "short prompt" --show-ids
# output: [101, 102, 2]  <-- trailing pad id 2
```

Leo: For the perf run, I'd prefer we validate config first. I found a failing lint in the serving manifest: `batch.max_tokens` was set to 4096 which exceeds the model's effective context when accounting for prompt+response. Suggest setting `batch.max_tokens=2048` and `batch.max_batch_size=8` for the smoke run. That keeps p95 under 300ms in our baseline hardware.

Devon: Adding those changes now. Samir can you drop the small config snippet you want in the manifest? I'll push and ping for a quick CR.

Samir: Yup, use this minimal override in the manifest for a smoke run: 
```json
{
  "batch": {
    "max_tokens": "2048",
    "max_batch_size": "8",
    "target_token_count": "1024"
  },
  "tokenizer": {
    "pad_token_id": "2",
    "padding": "false"
  }
}
```
(we treat these as strings in the manifest parser — the loader casts types)

Devon: Pushed change to branch `delta/onboard/smoke` and created a tiny PR. @Maria @Samir please quick look — it's two lines.

infra-bot: perf-run queued: https://perf/redwood/runs/97821 (Delta-v1 smoke, batch=max_tokens:2048, batch_size:8). Estimated runtime ~4m.

qa-bot: Smoke results: p50=78ms, p95=310ms, throughput=18 req/s (batching enabled). Observed one outlier at 1.1s — traced to tokenization step adding pad leading to cache miss. Summary log: s3://perf-logs/delta/97821/smoke.log

Leo: Outlier makes sense. Recommend we enable prefix-KV caching for the smoke sweep and re-run before full benchmarks. That should remove the tokenizer-induced cache cold-start.

Devon: Good call. I'll flip caching on in the manifest and re-run after the PR goes green. Also leaving a note in the onboarding checklist about double-checking `pad_token_id` when converting HF -> our runtime.

Maria: ACK. Also scheduling a lightweight tokenizer unit test to catch pad token presence.

Devon: thanks team — will follow up after the second smoke. If anyone wants to join the perf window, I'll post the time. :shipit:
